about_the_game:
✈️ A Simple Job – Airlines – Just sit still… what could possibly go wrong? 🪑🔴

Welcome back to A Simple Job, now way up in the clouds, where your new job sounds simpler than ever:
Sit down. Stay seated. And whatever you do don’t stand up.

Sounds easy? Think again. 😇
While the world outside is falling apart and a deranged onboard computer thinks it’s your therapist, your only task is… to just sit still.
And that’s harder than you’d expect.

💺 What to expect:
🛑 Your only job: Sit still. (What could possibly happen?)
🎙️ A new voice with a pilot’s license, a fear of heights, and way too much to say
🌀 New endings from “unexpected exit” to “philosophical crash landing”
📽️ Safety videos that offer more threats than advice
🏆 New achievements like “Still sitting (for now)” or “Pretty sure the seat hates me”
🥜 Snacks. And questions you never wanted to ask.

So… take a seat. Stay calm.
And whatever you do don’t stand up.
Or do you? 👀
